verdict.rationale: Finix is a payments platform, so agent-initiated checkout is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents no agentic-commerce protocol support, no delegated payment credentials, and no agent checkout on split-funds marketplace flows. The MCP server only answers questions about the Finix API, which is an adjacent developer aid rather than agent-buyer checkout.

support.subject: As a developer, the platform is ready for agent buyers — documented support for agent-initiated checkout on marketplace transactions (agentic-commerce protocols, delegated payment credentials) that works with split funds flows
